tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Screen background behind everything. Near-black with a green bias. Never pure #000.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: HUD panel fill, over the map. Pair with backdrop-filter: blur(2px).

tokens.name: phosphor
tokens.usage: THE colour. Primary text, active controls, selected map objects, your route. Every other tone is this at lower strength.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text: prose descriptions, list items, inactive button labels.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, field labels, units. Lowest strength allowed for text (4.6:1 or better on ground in every phosphor).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Hover borders, panel border of a focused or dragged panel.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Button, input and select borders at rest. Strength is set per phosphor to keep 3:1.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Panel outline. Decorative frame only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-faint
tokens.usage: Dividers inside panels, dotted rows in data readouts.

tokens.name: fill-active
tokens.usage: Pressed or selected button background.

tokens.name: fill-body
tokens.usage: Interior fill of large map bodies and selected regions.

tokens.name: scanline
tokens.usage: 1px scanline every 3px, laid over the whole screen and the loader.

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Behind a modal panel, when one is truly modal.

tokens.name: signal-caution
tokens.usage: Caution: slow traffic, low fuel, weak signal. Always paired with a pattern or word, never colour alone.

tokens.name: signal-alert
tokens.usage: Critical: road closed, jam, lost signal, errors. Use for marks and short labels only (6.6:1).

tokens.name: map-grid-major
tokens.usage: Map grid every 10 units. Fades out when zoomed in on streets.

tokens.name: map-grid-minor
tokens.usage: Map grid every unit.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Water fill (lakes, sea, rivers). Edge drawn with map-water-edge.

tokens.name: map-water-edge
tokens.usage: Coastline and riverbank stroke, 1px.

tokens.name: map-park
tokens.usage: Parks and green space: dot pattern at 6px pitch, no fill.

tokens.name: map-building
tokens.usage: Building footprint fill at street zoom.

tokens.name: map-building-edge
tokens.usage: Building footprint outline, 1px.

tokens.name: map-road-minor
tokens.usage: Local streets, 1px.

tokens.name: map-road-major
tokens.usage: Arterials, 1.6px.

tokens.name: map-road-highway
tokens.usage: Highways and motorways, 2.4px, double-line at street zoom.

tokens.name: map-label
tokens.usage: Street and place names on the map.

tokens.name: map-route
tokens.usage: Active route line, 2.6px with a phosphor glow (shadow route-glow).

tokens.name: map-route-alt
tokens.usage: Alternative routes, 1.3px dashed 4/5.

styles.name: boot-title
styles.usage: Loader / splash title. Scale 20px to 34px with clamp().

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Name of the selected object at the top of a detail panel.

styles.name: app-title
styles.usage: App name in the top bar. Paired with a 10px subtitle at 0.3em.

styles.name: readout-big
styles.usage: Live clock, ETA, speed. Always tabular numbers.

styles.name: cap
styles.usage: Uppercase caption above a value or group. Colour ink-muted.

styles.name: cap-small
styles.usage: Term in a data readout; tab labels inside narrow panels.

styles.name: prose
styles.usage: Descriptions and briefs. Sentence case, max 75ch, colour ink-soft.
styles.sample: Heavy congestion on the bridge approach. Expect 8 extra minutes.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Default body and value text. Uppercase for labels, any case for values.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Help strip, keyboard hints, secondary list lines.
styles.sample: SCROLL ZOOM · DRAG PAN · R RECENTER

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside dotted data rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a panel; small panel padding.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Screen edge inset for floating panels.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding (horizontal); phone gutter.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Gap between groups in the top bar.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every panel, button, input and tile. This system has no rounded rectangles.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: Only for live indicators, map pins and ring markers.

tokens.name: chamfer-panel
tokens.usage: Clipped top-left and bottom-right corners of floating HUD panels (clip-path).

tokens.name: chamfer-drop
tokens.usage: Same cut on drop-down panels.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Borders, grid, orbits/roads at rest, dividers.

tokens.name: stroke-select
tokens.usage: Selected or hovered path.

tokens.name: stroke-route
tokens.usage: Active route.

tokens.name: stroke-bracket
tokens.usage: Target brackets around the selected object.

tokens.name: dur-control
tokens.usage: Button and border colour changes.

tokens.name: dur-panel
tokens.usage: Panel fade in/out.

tokens.name: dur-pop
tokens.usage: Panel scale-in transform, with ease-pop.

tokens.name: dur-blink
tokens.usage: Live-indicator blink cycle (opacity 1 to 0.25 and back).

tokens.name: dur-boot-fade
tokens.usage: Loader fading away into the live map.

tokens.name: ease-pop
tokens.usage: Panels arriving. Fast start, soft landing.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Fades.

tokens.name: glow-primary
tokens.usage: The one bright object: the star, your position dot.

tokens.name: route-glow
tokens.usage: Vehicles, the route line, the selected marker.
